subtitle: When Healing Came Under the King’s Gaze

panels.shot: low-angle dramatic wide of a royal court as a physician stands between a reclining noble on a couch and stern officials
panels.action: Kautilya’s State Physician stands tense in a torchlit hall, one hand on a medicine box, while robed officials of Pataliputra watch him from the king’s dais in a scene of judgment and duty.

dialogue.text: In the age of Arthashastra, the healer’s art stood under royal law, where one wrong cut could bring not only death, but a king’s punishment.

i18n.hi: अर्थशास्त्र के दौर में वैद्य की कला राजकानून के अधीन थी, जहाँ एक गलती से मौत ही नहीं, राजा की सज़ा भी मिल सकती थी।

panels.shot: epic bird’s-eye over ancient Pataliputra by the Ganga at dawn
panels.action: The wide wooden palisades and long streets of Pataliputra stretch beside the Ganga, with smoke from hearths rising as traders, soldiers, monks and artisans begin their day.

dialogue.text: Long after the first Maurya kings, in the shadow of Pataliputra’s walls, thinkers stitched together a harsh, clear vision of rule: the Arthashastra.

i18n.hi: पहले मौर्य सम्राटों के बाद, पाटलिपुत्र की दीवारों की छाया में, विचारकों ने राजसत्ता की सख्त, साफ तस्वीर बुनी: अर्थशास्त्र।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a palm-leaf manuscript being written in lamplight
panels.action: A scholar’s hand, with ink-stained nails, carefully inscribes neat characters onto a palm leaf, while bundles of older, worn leaves lie tied nearby, hinting at layers of text.

dialogue.text: On palm leaves and memory, over generations, jurists, ministers and teachers shaped this text, attributed to Kautilya, yet layered through the early centuries before and after the Common Era.

i18n.hi: ताड़पत्रों और यादों पर, पीढ़ी दर पीढ़ी, न्यायविदों, मंत्रियों और आचार्यों ने इस ग्रंथ को गढ़ा, कौंٹिल्य से जोड़ा, पर परतें युगों तक जुड़ती रहीं।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a royal records office with shelves of tablets and sealed bundles
panels.action: In a cool, shaded chamber, clerks sit cross-legged amid stacks of records as a superintendent dictates to a scribe, pointing to a list that includes fees and professions.

dialogue.text: The Arthashastra was not a diary of one king’s day. It was a manual of imagination, a model of how a sharp, watchful state might control grain, roads, spies—and even healers.

i18n.hi: अर्थशास्त्र किसी एक राजा की डायरी नहीं था। यह कल्पना की किताब थी, तेज, चौकस राज्य की गाइड—अनाज, सड़कें, जासूस, यहाँ तक कि वैद्य भी सब उसके दायरे में।

panels.shot: profile medium close-up of the physician examining a patient in a modest city clinic
panels.action: Kautilya’s State Physician gently lifts the eyelid of a coughing patient in a small, open clinic, shelves of herbs and mortar bowls behind him, while an assistant waits with a clay cup.

dialogue.text: In this vision, the physician was no wandering mystic. He was a public actor, his hand on the sick and his name on the king’s lists.

i18n.hi: इस सोच में वैद्य कोई भटकता तांत्रिक नहीं, वह जनसेवक है—हाथ बीमार पर, नाम राजा की सूचियों में।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder shot of the physician standing before a royal official holding a tally board
panels.action: The physician stands with folded hands before a stern official who holds a wooden board marked with lines, while another clerk counts coins into a bowl.

dialogue.text: Book Two, among superintendents and guilds, turns to fees and penalties. The healer’s income, like the trader’s toll, fell under measured, written rule.

i18n.hi: द्वितीय अध्याय में, निरीक्षकों और शिल्पसंघों के बीच, फीस और जुर्माने की बात है—वैद्य की कमाई भी व्यापारी की चुंगी की तरह लिखित नियमों में बंधी।

panels.shot: close-up on the physician’s face, caught between concern and calculation
panels.action: The physician’s brow is furrowed as he listens, eyes lowered in respect yet alert, a faint sheen of sweat catching the lamplight.

dialogue.text: The text names him, sets his proper fee, and binds him to standards. Healing becomes not only compassion, but contract.

i18n.hi: ग्रंथ वैद्य का नाम लेता है, तय मज़दूरी बांधता है, और मानक तय करता है—इलाज सिर्फ दया नहीं, एक अनुबंध बन जाता है।

panels.shot: medium shot in a quiet courtyard where the physician speaks to a wary family about a risky treatment
panels.action: In a shaded courtyard, the physician kneels beside a low cot, explaining with open palms as a family listens anxiously, one elder gripping a wooden pillar.

dialogue.text: The Arthashastra demands that before dangerous remedies, the physician must give notice. The risk is named; the family, informed; the state, aware.

i18n.hi: अर्थशास्त्र कहता है, खतरनाक औषध देने से पहले वैद्य को खबर देना अनिवार्य है—जोख़िम साफ बोले, परिजन जानें, राज्य भी सजग रहे।

panels.shot: intimate mid-shot of the physician preparing a sharp instrument beside a patient
panels.action: By lamplight, the physician heats a metal lancet over a small flame, a patient lying still on a mat, eyes closed, a bowl of herbs nearby.

dialogue.text: For cuts, cautery, strong drugs, the text is clear: danger requires warning. Silence itself could become an offence.

i18n.hi: काट-छांट, दाग-धप्पा, तीखी दवाओं पर आदेश साफ है: ख़तरे से पहले चेतावनी जरूरी, चुप्पी खुद जुर्म बन सकती है।

panels.shot: low, tense angle of the physician mid-treatment as assistants restrain the patient
panels.action: The physician leans in, steady, as two assistants hold the patient’s shoulders; outside the doorway, a child peeks in, clutching a doorway post.

dialogue.speaker: kautilya_s_state_physicians
dialogue.text: Hold firm. The king’s law watches my hand as much as fate.

i18n.hi: धीरज रखो—मेरे हाथ पर जितनी नज़र भाग्य की है, उतनी ही राजा के कानून की।

panels.shot: sudden wide shot of the clinic door opening as a royal messenger enters
panels.action: The clinic’s reed curtain is thrust aside as a royal messenger steps in, wearing a badge of office, while the physician rises from beside the patient.

dialogue.text: If the patient died, or suffered harm, the law did not turn away. The king’s agents could cross the healer’s threshold.

i18n.hi: अगर रोगी मर गया या हानि हुई तो कानून मुँह नहीं मोड़ता—राजा के दूत सीधे वैद्य के द्वार पर पहुँच सकते हैं।

panels.shot: medium two-shot of the physician and a royal judge in a small hearing space
panels.action: In a bare hall, the physician stands before a seated judge, who listens with arms folded, while a scribe sits to one side, stylus poised.

dialogue.text: The Arthashastra names fines for negligence, harsher penalties when death follows rash treatment. The healer must answer not only to conscience, but to the court.

i18n.hi: अर्थशास्त्र लापरवाही पर जुर्माने गिनाता है, और उतावले इलाज से मौत पर कड़ी सज़ा—वैद्य को सिर्फ अंतरात्मा नहीं, अदालत के सामने भी जवाब देना होगा।

panels.shot: close-up on the judge’s hand as he places a small pile of fines on the table, with the physician’s hands visible
panels.action: A judge’s hand pushes forward a small stack of coins, while the physician’s hands remain clasped, knuckles tense, on the edge of the platform.

dialogue.text: In this scheme, punishment flows along lines of status, cause, and intent. A misstep costs silver, status—sometimes freedom.

i18n.hi: यह व्यवस्था सज़ा को जात, कारण और इरादे की रेखाओं पर बहाती है—एक चूक से चाँदी, मान-सम्मान, कभी आज़ादी तक चली जाती है।

panels.shot: wide shot of a bustling street where physicians, traders, and artisans work under the gaze of a patrol
panels.action: On a busy avenue, the physician walks past stalls and workshops as a patrol of royal guards moves through, their presence a constant reminder of authority.

dialogue.text: Upinder Singh reads in such laws a state that tied welfare to order. Roads, weights, healers, all placed under the same stern eye.

i18n.hi: उपेन्द्र सिंह ऐसे नियमों में एक ऐसा राज्य देखते हैं जो भलाई को अनुशासन से बाँधता है—सड़कें, बाट, वैद्य—सब एक ही सख़्त निगाह के नीचे।

panels.shot: medium shot of the physician treating a poor laborer on a roadside, with a soldier watching
panels.action: The physician binds a band around a laborer’s arm at the roadside, while a nearby soldier leans on his spear, observing with detached interest.

dialogue.text: Care for the vulnerable could be encouraged, yet always within the frame of discipline. Protection of bodies and protection of rule met in the healer’s hands.

i18n.hi: कमज़ोरों की देखभाल बढ़ाई जा सकती थी, पर हमेशा अनुशासन की सीमा में—शरीर की रक्षा और राज की रक्षा, दोनों वैद्य के हाथ मिलते हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in on the physician alone at night, copying portions of the code by a lamp
panels.action: At night, the physician sits cross-legged, copying lines from a legal manuscript by a flickering oil lamp, his face lit half in light, half in shadow.

dialogue.text: Patrick Olivelle shows how this text grew, composite and debated, yet its message is sharp: knowledge is power, and the king must bind both.

i18n.hi: पैट्रिक ओलिवेल दिखाते हैं कि यह ग्रंथ जोड़-जोड़ कर, बहसों में बढ़ा, फिर भी आवाज़ साफ है: ज्ञान ही शक्ति है, और राजा दोनों को बाँधना चाहता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of the physician training a younger apprentice in a courtyard, with a distant glimpse of the palace
panels.action: In a quiet courtyard, the physician guides a young apprentice’s hand over a pulse, while in the far background the palace rises above rooftops.

dialogue.speaker: kautilya_s_state_physicians
dialogue.text: Remember: we serve the sick—but also the law that measures us.

i18n.hi: याद रखो—हम रोगी की सेवा करते हैं, पर उस कानून की भी जो हमें तौलता है।

panels.shot: high-angle shot of the city showing clinics, markets, and the palace connected like a web
panels.action: From above, the city’s lanes reveal clinics, markets and shrines all feeding into wider roads that lead toward the central palace complex, like strands to a hub.

dialogue.text: Not every village healer knew or followed this manual. Yet the Arthashastra’s web shows a new idea: that even medicine belongs within the state’s net.

i18n.hi: हर गाँव का वैद्य इस ग्रंथ को न जानता था, न मानता, पर अर्थशास्त्र का जाल एक नई सोच दिखाता है: कि दवा भी अब राज्य की पकड़ में है।

panels.shot: extreme close-up on the physician’s steady hands preparing a simple remedy, dissolving into a modern silhouette of a hospital in the distance
panels.action: The physician’s hands crush herbs in a mortar, and in the hazy distance the outline of a later-age stone hospital rises, faint and symbolic.

dialogue.text: From these early rules on notice, fees, and fines, a question still travels to us: when healers hold lives, who should hold the healers to account?

i18n.hi: इन शुरुआती नियमों—सूचना, फीस और दंड—से एक सवाल आज तक चला आता है: जब वैद्य के हाथ में जान हो, तो वैद्य के हाथ पर किसकी नज़र हो?

subtitle_i18n.en: When Healing Came Under the King’s Gaze
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब इलाज पर पड़ी राजा की नज़र
